title: Dates in Chinese: 年, 月, 号 and Days of the Week (HSK 1)
description: How to say the date in Chinese: year, month and day in big-to-small order, 二月 vs 两个月, days of the week with 星期, and HSK 1 examples.
h1: Dates: 年, 月, 号 and Days of the Week
lede: Chinese dates go from the biggest unit to the smallest: year (年 nián), then month (月 yuè), then day (号 hào), then the day of the week (星期 xīngqī). So 17 October 2026 is 2026年10月17号.

paras: Year + 年, month + 月, day + 号. The order never changes, so a learner's most common mistake is to follow English and say 十七号十月. The correct order is 十月十七号.

Years are read one digit at a time: 2026年 is èr líng èr liù nián, not "two thousand and twenty-six". Months are just the numbers 一 to 十二 plus 月, so 一月 is January and 十二月 is December. In speech the day is 号; in writing, on forms and signs, you will also see 日 (rì).

examples.py: Jīntiān shì èr líng èr liù nián shí yuè shíqī hào.
Xiànzài shì èr líng èr liù nián.
Tā qùnián jiǔ yuè qù Zhōngguó le.
examples.en: He went to China last September.

sections.h2: 二月 is February, 两个月 is two months
paras: A month name uses the plain number with no measure word: 二月 is February. To count how many months, add 个 and use 两 for two: 两个月 is "two months". Mixing these up is a very common mistake, so never say 两月.

examples.py: Xiànzài shì èr yuè, tiān hěn lěng.
examples.en: It's February now, and it's very cold.

examples.zh: 他在中国工作了两个月。
examples.py: Tā zài Zhōngguó gōngzuò le liǎng ge yuè.
examples.en: He worked in China for two months.
Which month are you going to China?

sections.h2: Days of the week with 星期
paras: Monday to Saturday are 星期 plus a number: 星期一 is Monday, 星期六 is Saturday. Sunday is different: 星期天 in speech or 星期日 in writing, never 星期七. To ask which day it is, put 几 where the number goes: 星期几.
For "next" and "last", use 下个 and 上个: 下个星期三 is next Wednesday, 上个月 is last month. For years, use 去年, 今年 and 明年 instead.

examples.en: I don't have classes on Sunday.

examples.py: Xià ge xīngqīsān wǒ qù yīyuàn.
examples.en: I'm going to the hospital next Wednesday.

sections.h2: Asking the date, negatives and word order
paras: To ask the date, put 几 in place of the numbers: 几月几号. You don't need 是 when you give the date, but you do need it in a negative: 今天不是星期六, not 今天不星期六.
When you say when something happens, the date goes before the verb, either before or after the subject: 我们十月二十号回家 or 十月二十号我们回家. Putting it at the end, as in English, is wrong.

examples.zh: 明天不是十号，是十一号。
examples.py: Míngtiān bú shì shí hào, shì shíyī hào.
Wǒmen shí yuè èrshí hào huí jiā.

worksheet.title: Chinese Dates Worksheet: HSK 1 Printable with Answers
worksheet.description: A free printable worksheet on dates in Chinese for HSK 1: 19 exercises (年, 月, 号 and 星期, word order, fix the mistake) with an answer key.

exercises.h2: Choose 年, 月, 号 or 星期
exercises.instructions: Write 年, 月, 号 or 星期 in each gap. The English tells you what the sentence means.

items.en: What day of the week is it today?
It's December now, and it's very cold.
Next Monday I'm going to the hospital.
On what date are you going home?
I lived in China for two months.

exercises.instructions: Write the words as one correct sentence.

items.en: We're going to the shop on Saturday.
My dad doesn't work on Sundays.

exercises.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.en: I studied Chinese for two months.
